name: Folder Change Color, View URL, Translate Page
description: Adds a 'Change Color…' option to the right-click menu on sidebar folders (any custom color from a color wheel, not just the built-in preset palette), a tab tooltip showing the page's title and full URL (port included), and a '번역하기' page-context-menu item that reopens Firefox's full-page translation panel any time.
author: you
